why: Macworld answers this with a hands-on review of one Ugreen dock (plus an updated upgrade guide), so one major reviewer is in the results with testing, but only for a single product. Everything else is recycled-template Amazon listicles, one untested niche pick page, a brand store and off-target pages about the Mac mini itself or bare enclosures. A page that tests several docks head-to-head with measured SSD speeds and current prices could get in, but would compete with Macworld.
